public.privacyPage.ifYouIncludeAnotherPersonSDa: If you include another person's data in a CV, such as a referee's details, ensure you may lawfully use it and limit it to information needed for recruitment.
public.privacyPage.withoutSigningInCvAndSetupDr: Without signing in, CV and setup drafts may be stored only in the browser's local storage. After sign-in, the same storage holds the session token and an auxiliary username. Someone using the same browser profile may access them, so sign out and clear site data after using a shared device.
public.privacyPage.cvStudioDoesNotStoreAnAnonym: CV Studio does not store an anonymous marketing event queue or use Google Analytics or advertising pixels. Technically necessary browser storage operates without a consent banner because it serves only the requested functionality and session security.
public.privacyPage.pdfImportAiAndJobAdverts: 4. PDF import, AI and job adverts
public.privacyPage.theOriginalPdfIsReadForImpor: The original PDF is read for import and is not retained as a file after the operation. The structured import result, file name and size, status and a safe error code may be retained. Depending on the feature, PDF pages may be converted to images and sent to Cloudflare Workers AI or, when the relevant feature is configured, OpenAI.
public.privacyPage.theAiAssistantSendsOpenaiAnI: The AI assistant sends OpenAI an instruction and the document scope needed to respond. Job tailoring may retrieve a public page specified by the user; that site's operator then receives a request from CV Studio's server infrastructure. AI results may contain errors and require the user's review.
public.privacyPage.interviewsSaveQuestionsAnswe: Interviews save questions, answers, the selected CV source, job advert and result preview on the account. Confirmed information stays in an isolated interview or enters the career profile if the user explicitly selects it. Questions and generation send necessary information to OpenAI. Profiles can be edited and deleted after Pro expires. Deleting an interview deletes its isolated information, but not facts stored in the account profile or created CVs; deleting a profile does not delete previous documents or interview history. Account export and deletion include profiles and interviews. Interview operation logs record the event type and cost, without answer content.
public.privacyPage.theServiceIsNotIntendedToPro: the service is not intended to process such data. Do not upload it in documents, photos, job adverts or AI instructions. If a professional CV needs health or adjustment information, add it to the final document outside CV Studio.
public.privacyPage.aiDoesNotMakeDecisionsProduc: AI does not make decisions producing legal effects or similarly significant effects on the user. Content selection, accepting changes and sending the CV always remain the user's responsibility.

public.privacyPage.theServiceIsAvailableWorldwi: The service is available worldwide, and some providers are based or operate infrastructure outside the European Economic Area, particularly in the United States. Transfers outside the EEA rely on appropriate mechanisms under Chapter V GDPR, such as an adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework where the recipient and transfer meet its conditions. Information about the applicable safeguard can be requested from the controller's contact address.
public.privacyPage.theExactCloudRegionDependsOn: The exact cloud region depends on the active production configuration. The controller does not promise storage exclusively in Poland; deployment configuration should select European regions when available.
public.privacyPage.accountsProjectsCvElementsPh: Accounts, projects, CV elements, photos, drafts and career profiles, interviews, import results, usage counters and saved AI responses are retained until the user deletes them or the account. AI responses currently have no additional automatic deletion deadline.
public.privacyPage.sessionTokensNormallyExpireA: Session tokens normally expire after 7 days. Single-use email verification links expire after 24 hours; the database stores their irreversible hash.
public.privacyPage.stripeRecordsIncludingRawWeb: Stripe records, including raw webhook event content, are retained until account deletion. Once Live payments are enabled, some billing data may be retained longer where required by tax or accounting law or to defend claims.
public.privacyPage.technicalLogsAreRetainedAcco: Technical logs are retained according to the active Render plan and settings. The controller limits log content and should not record documents or secrets in logs.
public.privacyPage.correspondenceIsRetainedWhil: Correspondence is retained while handling the matter and until the time limits for pursuing or defending claims expire.
public.privacyPage.afterDeletionRecordsMayRemai: After deletion, records may remain for a limited time in providers' rotating backups. They are not used operationally and disappear according to the backup cycle.
public.privacyPage.accountDeletionImmediatelyRe: Account deletion immediately removes relationships and records from the active database. Private files are physically deleted through a retry queue so a temporary storage failure cannot restore account access. Deletion does not cover data independent controllers such as Stripe or Google must retain under their own legal basis.
public.privacyPage.passwordsAreStoredAsArgonIdH: Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes, with older records migrated from bcrypt. The API verifies the token and document owner before serving files; S3 objects are private, file names do not determine storage paths, and sign-in attempts and request sizes are limited. Production connections use HTTPS. However, no system can provide an absolute security guarantee.
public.privacyPage.withinTheLimitsOfGdprYouMay: Within the limits of GDPR, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where consent is the basis, you may withdraw it without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

public.publicPages.transferContentFromYourExist: Transfer content from your existing CV
public.publicPages.afterCreatingAnAccountUpload: After creating an account, upload a PDF CV. CV Studio extracts its content and places it in your chosen template. Check the result before downloading. Import does not copy the original appearance, and extracted data may need corrections. Free includes one successful import per month.
public.publicPages.withProAfterFillingACvFrom: With Pro, after filling a CV from an import, choose ‘Add to your CV through an interview’ to add further experience.
public.publicPages.saveYourProjectOrDownloadAPd: Save your project or download a PDF
public.publicPages.saveStoresAnEditableCvOnYour: ‘Save’ stores an editable CV on your account. ‘Download PDF’ creates a file from the current document but does not save the latest project changes. Both require an account. If saving fails, keep the tab open and retry from the editor.
public.publicPages.afterSigningInGoToMyDocument: After signing in, go to ‘My documents’ and choose a project to edit. You can also bookmark a document's address; only its account owner can open it. A draft created without signing in stays in this browser and disappears if its data is cleared.
